goalZh: 会用第三人称单数说别人的作息,读准动词词尾的 -s
canDoZh: 能说说室友或家人每天做什么,用对 he / she 后面动词的 -s

newItems.noteZh: wake up 是醒,get up 是起床:I wake up at seven, but I get up at 7:30.;连读 "way-kup"。
ee 是长音 /iː/;词尾 p 双唇闭上就好,不要读成 "slee-pu"。
play video games 打游戏,play basketball 打篮球;第三人称 plays 读 /pleɪz/。
v 要上齿轻咬下唇,别读成 w;一般用复数:play video games。
看电视、看节目用 watch,看书用 read;第三人称 watches 读 /ˈwɑːtʃɪz/。
watch a show 看剧、看节目。
go to the gym 去健身房;g 在这里读 /dʒ/。
连读像 "wor-kout";美国大学生很爱健身,学校健身房一般对学生免费。
five times a week 一周五次;next week 下周;ee 是长音 /iː/。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hey, Lei! How's it going with your roommate?
lines.zh: 嘿,磊!你和室友处得怎么样?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Good! But Ethan wakes up at eleven and gets up at noon.
lines.zh: 挺好的!不过伊森十一点才醒,中午才起床。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: At noon? Does he have class in the morning?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: And in the afternoon? Does he work?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: No. He works out at the gym five times a week.
lines.zh: 不打工。他一周去健身房锻炼五次。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Wow! Does he study at night?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Not really. He plays video games and watches shows.
lines.zh: 不怎么学。他打游戏、看剧。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: He goes to bed at three in the morning!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: That's a freshman thing! They sleep in the morning and play at night.
lines.zh: 大一新生都这样!上午睡觉,晚上玩。

grammar.titleZh: he / she 后面的动词加 -s
grammar.bodyZh:
说别人(he / she / Ethan / my mom)平时做什么,动词要加 -s:He gets up at noon.。中文"我起床""他起床"动词不变,所以这是中国学生最容易漏的地方。主语是 I / you / we / they 或复数名词(freshmen)时不加:They sleep in the morning.。
怎么加:一般直接加 -s(gets、plays);以 s、sh、ch、x、o 结尾加 -es(watches、goes);辅音字母 + y 结尾,改 y 为 i 再加 -es(study → studies);have 要变成 has。
-s 的三种读音:在 /t/ /k/ /p/ 这类清辅音后读 /s/(gets、works、sleeps、wakes);在元音和浊辅音后读 /z/(plays、goes);在 s、sh、ch 后读 /ɪz/,多出一个音节(watches)。
否定和疑问借助 does,后面的动词回到原形:He doesn't study at night.(不说 doesn't studies);Does he have class? — No, he doesn't.(不说 Does he has…)。记住:-s 只出现一次,不在动词上,就在 does 上。

examples.text: Sofia's mom works at a hospital.
examples.zh: 索菲亚的妈妈在医院工作。

examples.text: Ethan plays video games and watches shows.
Does he have class in the morning? — No, he doesn't.
